what_to_detect: A creature spell cast through suspend's last-time-counter trigger gains haste, so the permanent it becomes is a legal attacker on the turn it enters.
near_miss: A creature that entered the battlefield this turn by any other means and has no haste is not a legal attacker.
record_fields: gen-3 card lines: a keyword line Haste with keys [] (granted by a resolved effect) and history
the Suspend play trigger's resolution: spell_cast (from_zone exile, without_paying) and keyword_change (Haste) events
